#### info-1 — Planar additive-DP optimum (InfoResearch96h-2)

- **Original target:** The replacement asked for proof that the optimized diamond-staircase family is optimal for every `epsilon>0`, or one explicit admissible measure strictly beating that entire family. After the supported refutation, the continuation asks for the exact unrestricted planar additive-DP squared-Euclidean optimum `V(epsilon)` over all Borel laws and every shift in the full closed diamond, for each finite `epsilon>0`, or the complete literal residual and first unproved step.
- **Adopted at exact scope:**
  - For every finite `epsilon>0`, the registered query-output-independent additive model has a uniquely optimal Borel probability law at named standard analysis inputs; the value and optimizer are characterized without an unevaluated outer minimization. Separately, the source gate gives all-kernel/additive KL value equality and extended additive attainment for pointwise finite budgets, nonnegative lower-semicontinuous coercive costs with `c(0)=0`, and a full closed Euclidean shift ball; it also covers finite-KL density with scalar cutoff repair and the registered full-diamond density cap `exp(epsilon)/2` and fixed-shift KL bound. Its countercontrol rejects the weaker vector source’s unqualified absolute-continuity clause.

Their later composition at `I233 + II280 + LAW642`, including LAW642’s value, geometry and all-law uniqueness inputs, covers every finite positive cost budget `C>0`, cofinal value sequence, both iterated limits and vanishing-error near-minimizers. At `C=V(epsilon)`, the finite-bin privacy infimum is approached from above but not attained; no fixed-family compactness, gap, rate or algorithm follows.

The separate prior MDA26 gates cover attaining staircases for nonnegative nondecreasing norm costs and a cost-independent maximal-decay radial law. Neither is an automatic registered diamond/Euclidean-MSE, publication-identity or algorithm claim.
  - At `LAW642` and the named ordinary-analysis inputs, the `NORM148` radial union supports attainment in the entire feasible finite-cost translated genuine-norm/arbitrary-Borel-profile class and the core-homothety criterion. The NEW separately reconstructed v241 proof at `LAW642 + NORM148` gives a unique exact diamond/rounded threshold: `epsilon_t=2 asinh(sqrt(s_t))`, with `s_t` the unique positive root of `2s^3-9s^2-108s-81=0`. For finite `epsilon>0`, the attained entire norm-radial class has a strict fixed-epsilon gap above the threshold and the same optimum at/below it. The no-continuous-version lemma retains its separate single-review-plus-parent scope; no positive continuous-density-class infimum gap follows.

Older three-owner arbitrary-law interval/sign/selector/moment work is baseline only, with `NOVELTY_UNCLEAR` and Kuroki `ACCESS_BLOCKED`.

On that side every feasible law has Euclidean cost at least `2V1/3`, with equality only as the unique optimizer law; above it `V<2V1/3`. The conditional union is `LAW642 + MDA per-cost(K=D,cost r²) + NORM148 + separated v241`, not MDA alone. The printed MDA body, v241 operative/review bodies and old review erratum remain the named NR cuts at this gate; SOURCE-MATCH-U1/publication priority remain open. Original v227 STOP and the later v259 administrative exposure/consumers ZERO persist.
